title: Persistency Interest Bonus Credited on Universal Life Insurance Surrenders
content:
**Bulletin.** A surrendering Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy earns a persistency interest bonus that follows the policy year of the surrender, counted from the issue date to the surrender's effective date. Where, on a full surrender, the part of the account value above the loan balance is carried forward to the effective date at the tier's current fixed account rate, the bonus is added to that rate.

| Policy year of the surrender | Persistency interest bonus (annual) |
|---|---|
| **10** or later (the long bonus year) | Long bonus, **0.5%** (0.005) |
| **5** through 9 (at least the mid bonus year, before the long bonus year) | Mid bonus, **0.25%** (0.0025) |
| 1 through 4 | No bonus |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical).**

| Policy year | Bonus | Ashgrove Protection UL rate with the bonus (current fixed account rate 3.75%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | none | 3.75% |
| 5 | 0.25% | 4.00% |
| 9 | 0.25% | 4.00% |
| 10 | 0.5% | 4.25% |

Policy year 5 begins on the fourth policy anniversary and policy year 10 on the ninth.
